response.overview: 17 April 2017, I was 18 years old when I ran away from my house to pursue stand-up. I worked at a call centre and did odd part-time jobs for 3k/month with that to keep doing open mics. It’s been almost 10 years now. This is my first stand-up special with all the material built through those years. I am still chasing that feeling when I went up on stage that night for the first time. I never got that laugh again. I never got that applause again. I don’t know if I will ever get to feel that again. I am adding that video here, my first-ever performance. Most of those jokes are in this special.
response.title: Mohd Suhel: King of Kings
